Export separate vector PDFs from saved results. Set `run_plots: true` and supply
either `results_file` (native `results.rds`) or `data_dir` (historical
`theorem1_records.csv` and `theorem2_records.csv`). Paths are relative to this
notebook. Each export creates a new run subfolder beneath `output_dir`.

- `qq`: Theorem 1 components, marginal alpha, joint chi-square, and **debiased
  Theorem 2 only**. No reference bands are added.
- `hist_estimates`: overlaid $\widehat\Lambda_{ab}$ and $\widetilde\Lambda_{ab}$.
- `hist_errors`: overlaid $\widehat\Lambda_{ab}-\Lambda^\star_{ab}$ and
  $\widetilde\Lambda_{ab}-\Lambda^\star_{ab}$.

Histograms use saved estimates in the truth-aligned frame ($\Lambda_q$), with
$a,b$ indexing matrix entries. Diagonal entries of `Lambda_v` are multiplied by
$\sqrt{2}$; off-diagonal entries are unchanged. Both estimators share bins and
replications. Error histograms shift estimates by the true entry, preserving
density heights. The dotted reference marks the truth, or zero for errors.

The defaults select QQ plots across all saved sizes. For all individual figures
at $n=1000$, set `n: 1000` and `kinds: ["qq", "hist_estimates", "hist_errors"]`.
Use `n: null` to keep all saved sizes.
`nodes: "all"` selects all saved nodes. The dimension is read from `K` in the
input. For node-only runs without debiasing, choose `kinds: ["qq"]`.
`font: "latex"` uses Latin Modern and requires `pdflatex` with `lmodern`;
`font: "serif"` uses base-R text without TeX. `histogram_bins` sets the approximate
number of common bins. Sample sizes appear in filenames, not plot titles.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = TRUE, message = TRUE)
input_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
paths <- c(if (length(input_file) == 1L && !is.na(input_file) && nzchar(input_file)) dirname(input_file),
           getwd(), file.path(getwd(), "plots"), file.path(getwd(), "with_intercept", "plots"))
found <- paths[file.exists(file.path(paths, "plot_individual.R"))]
if (!length(found)) stop("Cannot locate plots/plot_individual.R.")
plot_root <- normalizePath(found[1], mustWork = TRUE)
source(file.path(plot_root, "plot_individual.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())
resolve <- function(x) if (grepl("^(/|[A-Za-z]:[/\\\\])", path.expand(x))) path.expand(x) else file.path(plot_root, x)
figures <- NULL
```

## Create figures

```{r export}
if (!isTRUE(params$run_plots)) {
  cat("No figures generated. Enable run_plots and supply one saved-results input.\n")
} else {
  inputs <- Filter(Negate(is.null), list(params$results_file, params$data_dir))
  if (length(inputs) != 1L) stop("Supply exactly one of results_file or data_dir.")
  output <- file.path(resolve(params$output_dir), paste0("run_", format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"), "_", Sys.getpid()))
  suffix <- 0L
  while (file.exists(output)) {
    suffix <- suffix + 1L
    output <- file.path(resolve(params$output_dir), paste0("run_", format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"), "_", Sys.getpid(), "_", suffix))
  }
  figures <- gfb_plot_saved(resolve(inputs[[1]]), output,
    nodes = params$nodes, models = params$models, sample_sizes = params$n,
    kinds = unlist(params$kinds), font = params$font,
    include_alpha_marginal = params$include_alpha_marginal,
    histogram_breaks = params$histogram_bins)
  knitr::kable(figures$figures)
  cat("PDF directory:", figures$output_dir, "\n")
}
```

`figure_audit.csv` records retained and excluded rows. `qq_points.csv` and
`histogram_values.csv` contain the plotted values; `input_hashes.csv` identifies
the source files. Failed or nonfinite rows are excluded explicitly. Values are
neither recentered nor rescaled to improve their appearance.
